Are you passionate about building innovative software solutions? At CoreIntels, we develop cutting-edge applications that power AI-driven products, scalable cloud platforms, and high-performance systems. Join us as a Software Engineer (New Grad) and work alongside experienced engineers to develop software that makes an impact.

Why You’ll Love This Job

As a Software Engineer (New Grad), you will be involved in designing, developing, and optimizing software solutions that solve real-world problems. You will collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data scientists to build applications that scale efficiently and perform at the highest level.

What You’ll Do

Design and develop high-quality software solutions for web, backend, and cloud-based applications

Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code in languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or Go

Build and optimize RESTful APIs and microservices

Work with relational and NoSQL databases to store and retrieve data efficiently

Participate in code reviews, debugging, and performance optimizations

Implement automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions

What You’ll Need

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

Strong programming skills in Python, Java, JavaScript, Go, or similar languages

Familiarity with web frameworks such as Node.js, React, or Spring Boot

Understanding of database systems, including SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis)

Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles

Experience with Git, version control, and agile development methodologies

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications

Internship or project experience in full-stack development, backend engineering, or DevOps

Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

Understanding of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes

Exposure to distributed systems and event-driven architectures

Experience with API development and integrations

What You’ll Get

Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses

Structured mentorship and career development programs

Opportunities to work on real-world, high-impact projects

Hybrid work environment with flexible work arrangements

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

Employee wellness programs, training, and upskilling opportunities

At CoreIntels, we believe in nurturing the next generation of software engineers by providing hands-on experience with modern technologies. If you are eager to build scalable and impactful software, apply today.
